## Corrected R1 Findings

The prior canonical-ordering defect is closed. The prior aggregate-resource-proof gap is closed under the normative contract identified by ADR 0005. Snapshot `docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/runs/447dd4cc5ef0dfa8894d54fdc79a1c15aaaedb84/inputs/source-snapshots/docs/architecture/decisions/0005-immutable-specialist-run-session.md:93`, original path `docs/architecture/decisions/0005-immutable-specialist-run-session.md:93`, delegates exact limits and semantics to the live run contract. Snapshot `docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/runs/447dd4cc5ef0dfa8894d54fdc79a1c15aaaedb84/inputs/source-snapshots/docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/specialist-run-contract.md:338`, original path `docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/specialist-run-contract.md:338`, distinguishes reachable constituent limits from conservative aggregate safeguards.

Snapshot `docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/runs/447dd4cc5ef0dfa8894d54fdc79a1c15aaaedb84/inputs/source-snapshots/test/specialist-run.test.mjs:948`, original path `test/specialist-run.test.mjs:948`, constructs a verified 16-agent package with sixteen exact 1,048,576-byte handoffs and exact 1,398,104-character base64 values. It proves forward/reverse convergence, restore equality, reinspection equality, complete-roster readiness, and constituent ceilings below both aggregate safeguards. Lines 1075 through 1137 prove reachable raw boundaries and one-unit-over rejection without truncation. Schema coverage at snapshot `docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/runs/447dd4cc5ef0dfa8894d54fdc79a1c15aaaedb84/inputs/source-snapshots/test/specialist-run-schema.test.mjs:339`, original path `test/specialist-run-schema.test.mjs:339`, covers 16 versus 17 rows, exact raw/base64 maxima, and over-limit values.

## Lifecycle Review

Create embeds the complete reverified package, exact goal and candidate bindings, an empty accepted set, and a detached frozen digest-bound value. Restore bounds raw bytes before parsing, enforces strict closed JSON, revalidates the embedded package, canonically decodes every raw handoff, re-runs V11 verification, enforces requirement-safe ordering and pass-only transitive dependency closure, and reconstructs the canonical session.

Record revalidates prior state and exact raw evidence before applying the required precedence: identical replay succeeds idempotently, conflicting settlement returns `SC4403`, post-route settlement returns `SC4405`, dependency-ineligible settlement returns `SC4404`, and aggregate excess returns `SC4402`. Verified non-pass outcomes record once as workflow routes and never satisfy dependencies.

Inspection revalidates the session, derives all selected blueprint statuses from the verified DAG, exposes only manifest-resolved eligible contracts, reverifies accepted evidence, preserves canonical ordering, globally marks unsettled work as session-routed after a non-pass, and returns integration readiness only after exact all-pass roster fan-in. Independent valid arrival permutations converge to identical session and inspection values. Returned sessions and inspections are detached and deeply frozen.

## Canonical Evidence

The authenticated gate receipt snapshot is `docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/runs/447dd4cc5ef0dfa8894d54fdc79a1c15aaaedb84/inputs/canonical-gate/canonical-gate-receipt.json`; its original path is `docs/specs/v12-ide-run-loop/evidence/release-review-r2/inputs/canonical-gates/447dd4cc5ef0dfa8894d54fdc79a1c15aaaedb84/canonical-gate-receipt.json`. It binds candidate `447dd4cc5ef0dfa8894d54fdc79a1c15aaaedb84`, unchanged source identity `sha256:f0236e395c5a0f8d99e0eb9d78779a5b86dc39a3a412edc520c8de76e664147c`, clean before/after state, exact `npm.cmd run verify`, exit code 0, and result `pass`.

Its authenticated raw stdout records 406 tests, 406 passes, zero failures, zero skips, and zero todos. It includes passing maximum-handoff aggregate and one-unit-over boundary tests, V10/V11/V12 dogfood, dry-run package inspection, and the installed-consumer compatibility gate. No test or host process was launched during this review; verification was assessed from the contract-required immutable receipt and raw logs.

## Outcome

`pass`. Corrected V12 lifecycle behavior, deterministic recovery, requirement-primary canonical evidence ordering, aggregate resource proof, dependency eligibility, exact fan-in, routing, and immutability are release-ready within this review domain.
